bibliographic.title: R E B I R T H
bibliographic.author: tetora
bibliographic.description:
Soon it will be your new beginning. Are you ready?

For the Neo-Twiny Jam 2026 where creators are limited to 500 words total for an Interactive Fiction. I wanted to make an afterword like I did for my first IF, but I think I'll do so after the jam officially ends.

(07/01/26: Added an afterword from the title page, replacing the original file. I will keep the original as a download just for history preservation.)

[495 words]
